StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Student details provided on the landing page modal (First Name, Second Name, Department)

id.description: Unique student identifier generated on first access

createdAt.description: Timestamp when student profile was recorded in Firestore

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when student profile was last updated

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Record of a completed timed CBT exam or workbook quiz session

id.description: Unique identifier for the quiz attempt

courseId.description: ID of the course (e.g. ges112, ges212, ges300)

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the quiz

grade.description: Letter grade (A, B, C, D, F)

timeSpentSeconds.description: Duration spent on the quiz in seconds

CourseProgress.title: CourseProgress
CourseProgress.description: Student learning progress and completion count per course

AdMetric.title: AdMetric
AdMetric.description: Aggregated metrics and unique click counts for an advertisement

uniqueClicks.description: Total count of unique devices that clicked and visited the ad

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when ad metric was last incremented

AdVisitor.title: AdVisitor
AdVisitor.description: Record of a unique device that viewed the full ad detail page

firstVisitedAt.description: Timestamp of the first visit from this device

TestConnection.title: TestConnection
TestConnection.description: Probe document to verify active database connectivity

/test/{docId}.description: Health probe path to verify client connectivity

/students/{studentId}/quizAttempts/{atte.description: Historical quiz attempts and exam scores for the student

/students/{studentId}/progress/{courseId.description: Course-specific learning progress and study metrics

/adMetrics/{adId}.description: Summary click and unique audience engagement metric for the ad

/adMetrics/{adId}/visitors/{deviceId}.description: Unique device record ensuring single click count per device
